bugs.error_message: Only first overlay text audible when playing back stitched narration (Xing header stripping was insufficient)
bugs.root_cause: Naive JS MP3 buffer concatenation fails because: (1) Xing/LAME VBR headers declare total frame count causing browsers to stop early, (2) synthetic silence frames have different encoding parameters than ElevenLabs output causing decoder confusion at frame boundaries. bugs.fix: Replaced entire audio-stitcher with ffmpeg-static based implementation. Uses ffmpeg concat filter (decode + re-encode) with anullsrc for silence gaps. Produces a spec-compliant single MP3. Added ffmpeg-static to serverExternalPackages in next.config.ts.

bugs.error_message: Overlay autosave fires mid-typing — debounce never resets while user keeps editing
bugs.root_cause: Autosave useEffect deps were [autoSaveStatus, onSave]. First keystroke flips status idle->pending; subsequent keystrokes keep it pending (no value change) so the effect does not re-run and the cleanup never fires, letting the original 6s timer reach completion while user is still typing. Triggers handleOverlaySave -> setLocalPages -> overlay prop ref change -> init() -> in-flight edits clobbered.
bugs.fix: Added `elements` to the autosave effect dep array. Each store mutation produces a new array ref, so the effect re-runs, cleanup clears the prior setTimeout, and a fresh 6s debounce window starts.
